item.title: Welcome to Frontpage
item.description: A better way to read the web — no trackers, no ads, just the content you care about.
item.content:encoded:
A Better Way to Read the Web

Frontpage is designed to give you a clean, focused environment for consuming your favorite content. No trackers, no ads, just the words and images you care about.

Key Features

Privacy First: Your reading habits are your business. We don't track what you read.

Clean Reader: Distraction-free reading experience for every article.

Organized: Groups your feeds into categories for easy management.

Fast: Built with Next.js and React for a snappy, app-like feel.

Since you are in a Guest Session, your feeds and progress are stored temporarily. To keep them forever, click the avatar icon in the top right to save your account.

Happy reading!
— The Frontpage Team
